# GoScript

> GoScript analyzes YouTube channels, extracts the script methodology behind their best videos, and writes new scripts built on the patterns that actually work.

## Links

- [Home](https://www.goscript.app/)
- [Blog](https://www.goscript.app/blog)
- [Pricing](https://www.goscript.app/pricing)

## About

GoScript is a web app for YouTube creators and scriptwriters. It deconstructs a channel's highest-performing videos into reusable patterns — hooks, retention curves, structure, and pacing — then generates new video scripts that follow those patterns.
